description:
Cast a copy of Seed Suture by paying {G/W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emergency Phytomedic. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Seed Suture, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G/W}.
Repeat.
